name: hand-drawn
title_zh: 把十八种手绘风格变成一句可用的绘图提示词
tagline_zh: 想要蜡笔、水墨还是吉卜力？不用再搜教程、凑关键词。报个风格名，立刻得到结构完整的提示词，还带参考图链接。
tagline_en: Crayon, ink, or Ghibli? Stop hunting for prompt recipes. Name a style, get a structured prompt with reference.
desc_en: Use when users ask for a hand-drawn or illustrated image prompt, name one of the repository's 18 numbered styles or the 3.1 stable variant, or mention triggers such as 亲子手绘、家庭蜡笔画、蜡笔、吉卜力、水墨、像素、淡彩速写、动画概念、水粉、北欧绘本、纸雕、软胶潮玩、墨线绘本、暖色扁平绘本、family-crayon-card、warm-flat-storybook. Produces prompt text or a formal reference-bearing call bundle and does not generate images.
why_zh: 内置18种编号风格+稳定变体，每种都拆解成可复用的提示词模板，并自动附带官方参考图。
why_en: Ships with 18 numbered styles plus a stable variant, each decomposed into reusable prompt templates with official reference.
limit_zh: 只产出提示词文本和参考链接，不生成图片。需要你自行接入绘图工具（如Midjourney、Stable Diffusio。
limit_en: Outputs only prompt text and reference links, no image generation. Requires your own drawing tool (e.g., MJ/SD). Covers only the 18 repo styles; no.
title_en: Turn 18 hand-drawn styles into a ready-to-use image prompt
